added.summary: An emitter's `trail <seconds> [<width>] [only]` draws a trail behind each particle: the path it took over the last <seconds>, remembered at eight points, a camera-facing strip in the particle's colour (and effect material) narrowing and fading to its tail, its width a share of the particle's; `only` draws the trails without the particles (a spark's streak, a comet). Billboards and mesh particles on both simulation paths; not sprite mode or sub-emitters' particles.
